verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS service on the Deel platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions API keys, tokens, scopes, or permission models. The OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path, and the llms.txt file only describes the company, so there is no evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
